The Implementation of a WebGPU-Based Volume Rendering Framework ... - MDPI
Mar 4, 2025However, many challenges remain to be addressed while performing a real-time interactive visualization of large-volume heterogeneous scalar datasets in a web environment. In this study, we propose a WebGPU-based volume rendering framework for an interactive visualization of ocean scalar data.
